notes: IS/BS/CF from 2006 10-K (filed 2007-02-22); release = Q4-2006 earnings release Ex-99.1 (8-K filed 2007-02-22) twelve-month columns.

BS has no 'Total liabilities' line; total_liabilities left null. Derived total liabilities (TL&E - equity) = 541,603.

Current 'Accrued pensions' (1,483) and 'Dividends payable' placed in other_current_liabilities; accrued_pensions = non-current 33,417.

cf: st_borrowings_net DERIVED = Proceeds from short-term borrowings 2,035 + Payments on short-term borrowings (3,192) + Amounts due banks, net 115 = (1,042). Release CF shows 'Net Change in Borrowings' (4,189) which also includes LT repayments (3,147).

Segment table not in release; taken from 10-K Note J. Segment special items DERIVED from Note J footnote: Europe includes rationalization charges 3,478 and gain 9,006 on sale of Ireland facility -> special_items = 3,478 - 9,006 = (5,528); adj_ebit derived.
Segment EBIT check: OI 232,970 + equity earnings 7,640 + other income 1,839 = 242,449 = consolidated segment EBIT.

adj_operating_income DERIVED: release does not tabulate; headline says 'Excluding non-recurring items, 2006 Full-Year operating income increases 48%'. 232,970 + 3,478 - 9,006 = 227,442 (Q4-2007 release text confirms 2006 adjusted operating income of $227.4 million).

Special items 2006 (MD&A/release): European (Ireland) rationalization charges 3,478 pre-tax / 3,478 after-tax ($0.08/diluted sh) for severance of 66 employees at Harris Ireland; gain on sale of Ireland facility 9,006 pre-tax / 7,204 after-tax ($0.17/sh), recorded as reduction of SG&A. Q4-2006: gain 9,006 and rationalization 472.

Other MD&A items 2006: higher bonus expense 18,010; product liability defense cost increase 7,585; FX favorable effect on net income 1,783. Effective tax rate 26.5% (2005: 20.5% incl. tax benefits 9,857 + 1,807).

Prior year (2005) non-recurring items per release: rationalization 1,761 (1,303 AT); tax benefits Ohio law 1,807 and prior-year resolution/repatriation 9,857; legal settlement gain 1,418 (876 AT) in Other income; loss on sale of business 1,942 (1,678 AT) in SG&A. 2005 adjusted NI 112,747, adj diluted EPS 2.67.

Sales change (MD&A): Europe price not disclosed; Europe components sum to 373,244 vs 372,308 reported (residual -936, implied Europe price = consolidated price 46,868 - NA 33,714 - Other 14,090 = -936). Other Countries acquisitions not disclosed; components sum to 294,113 vs 294,135 (residual +22, implied Other acq = consolidated 54,496 - NA 46,784 - Europe 7,690 = 22). Consolidated row and NA row reconcile exactly.
Dividends declared per share 0.79 from IS/equity statement; release shows cash dividends paid per share 0.76.
Release ROIC 19.9%; net operating working capital 507,873 (25.8% of prior-4-quarter sales).
Export sales: 2006 10-K reports North America export sales of 180,114; release reports export sales of $154.1 million (later 10-K labels 154,111 as U.S. export sales).
